verdict.rationale: Plaid is a financial-data and payments API platform, so asking whether it offers user-configurable background automations is a fair question. The evidence shows none. Plaid-side asynchronous processes and transaction updates that notify developers are an adjacent feature, not automations a user sets up to run on their own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
